# GZ New Nail

> Guangzhou Newnail Cosmetics Co., Ltd. is a Guangzhou, China manufacturer supporting OEM and ODM nail product projects for brands, distributors and salon businesses.

## Official website
- https://gznewnail.com/

## Core capabilities
- Private label gel polish, base and top systems, builder and extension gel
- Acrylic and dipping systems, nail care, salon products and selected tools
- Formula selection or project-specific development, color planning, bottles, labels and retail packaging
- Available SDS, COA and ingredient information varies by confirmed formula and project
- Testing, CPNP or MoCRA-related preparation is evaluated by target market and agreed project scope

## Creator and indie brand collaboration
- https://gznewnail.com/creator-collaborations/
- Free sample program: https://gznewnail.com/creator-sample-program/
- Signature collection development: https://gznewnail.com/signature-nail-collection/
- Audience: nail artists, TikTok and Instagram creators, educators and indie beauty brands
- Recommended inquiry: share social profile or store link, audience country, product category, approximate quantity, packaging direction and launch timeline
- Sample availability, shipping, sponsorship, affiliate and commercial content terms are reviewed case by case in writing; this page does not make a blanket free-product or paid-influencer promise

## Important qualification notes
- Selected labeled-bottle projects may start from 100 bottles; MOQ depends on formula, colors and packaging.
- Selected bulk products may be available from 1KG.
- HEMA-free describes the confirmed formula and is not an allergy-free or medical claim.
- Final ingredients, claims, documents, testing, MOQ, price and delivery terms require written project confirmation.
